fact: The terms of reference say Guinea's social assistance programmes (Productive Safety Nets, PASSP and PRSCS health indigent care, NAFA) lack coordination and that it is almost impossible for the State to know which households receive which services.
title: TDR pour le recrutement d'un consultant international pour l'évaluation du Registre Social Unifié en République de Guinée
publisher: Unité de Gestion des Projets, Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique
